notes.title: Update release
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
The update we announced last week is now live :
[list]
[*]The bug causing the leaderboards to be stucked in the "Loading..." state is fixed
[*]You can now correctly unlock the "Run, Forest, run!" success
[*]You can now correctly unlock the "Hail to the king, baby!" success
[/list]
Happy shooting ;)
